author: shinokuni
quote:
I don't understand what you guys did with GTA this time. I clearly don't get what the genius person in your dev team could imagine gamers would be happy with this relationship mechanic. It at best must have been a side quest. You guys forced me to play 50 hours **** hearing a person yapping all the time, creating unecesasry trouble and making me feeling miserable. I geniunely don't understand what was your idea. Did you think "it's fun"?

a game is made to be FUN. Do you really think your customers are into that? You broke the trust in Rockstar, 80 DOLLARS for that storyline is such a scam, I tried until the end to believe in you guys, but even the ending didn't even give me an emotion. I didn't care at all! Dialogues were boring, personalities were boring, Jason is boring, Lucia is beyond annoying, I just hoped at some point you would allow me to tell her to stop yapping, and there would be an option to move on with another storyline. Why? Because in real life I avoid those people, and you guys made me stay around Lucia for so long. I would have rather played Jason into his own story and see his character developemt. Seriously. I mean do you really think the writing was good? Or did your company became so massive you couldn't even speak your mind and everyoen knew it was bad? The graphics could save it somehow, but it's capped to 30 FPS. 30 FPS in 2026??? and what, this would be a console issue? no, that's a dev issue. I don't know if I will buy your next games honestly. 80 dollars for this, what a scam. I geniunely didn't have fun. This open world and level design was very well crafted, I can see you put a lot of effort into details, and for this I want to say well done to many of your teams, but whoever decided the storyline, the mechanics, the physics, the character development, the voice acting... this is horrendous. I mean it's straight the opposite of whatever gamers wants in a game, we just want to have fun. You remember Trevor, Mickael? see the difference? no? and what the hell are those reviews. 99 for this?

author: shinokuni
quote: Amazing game. Anno doesn't need to change a lot, but the new addons in Anno 117 are most welcomed. Well balanced, amazing graphics, total immersion! We can turn on / turn off war in-land, which is also smart. A great title and definitely Anno.
